meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Where growth comes from” with the muted eyebrow “Revenue mix · USD thousands”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Stack two monotone areas for Jan–Jun: Subscriptions ($k) at 186, 225, 208, 284, 312, 368 and Services ($k) at 140, 178, 190, 210, 245, 272. Use two chart colors with 65% and 25% fill opacity and a legend. Show $640k and a footer explaining the combined June revenue.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips. Use Jan–Jun month labels, a numeric vertical axis, dashed horizontal grid lines, and clean axes without tick marks or axis lines.
